title: One-sided Q3 graph bounds do not imply central A-context control
question: Do the two one-sided A^(-3/4) graph bounds used by the Q3 source lift imply the central conjugation bound ||A^(3/4) D A^(-3/4)|| needed by the EXP-001048 composition theorem?
method: Reuse the exact positive diagonal energy family A_n=diag(1,2^(4n),2^(8n)) and raising shift S, but set D_n=S A_n^(3/4) so the target is a single central conjugation context.
Compute ||D_n A_n^(-3/4)||, ||A_n^(-3/4)D_n||, ||A_n^(3/4)D_n A_n^(-3/4)|| and ||D_n|| exactly for n=1,2,3 in primary SymPy and independent Fraction lanes.
Compile Lean R231 for the exact 2^3, 2^6, 2^12 and 2^18 fixtures and preserve the finite-operator/Q3 scope firewall.
finding: The one-sided norms are 1 and 2^(-3n), while the single central context norm is 2^(6n)=64^n and the ordinary factor norm is 2^(3n). Therefore the one-sided graph estimates cannot by themselves imply the central A^(3/4) D A^(-3/4) context required by EXP-001048. This rejects an inference rule only; it does not identify the witness with an actual Q3 source difference or prove the actual Q3 central context unbounded.
decision_reason: This is the direct next test after EXP-001048: it isolates the missing single-factor central context rather than repeating the prior repeated-product target. The result routes the proof toward a product-level analytic/Frechet, heat-strip or state-weighted estimate.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite central-context inference boundary. It does not establish a Q3 no-go or a thermodynamic QFT.

Both one-sided orientations and their unequal exact values are retained.
The growing quantity is the single A^(3/4) D A^(-3/4) context missing in EXP-001048, not its repeated-product target.
A_n^(3/4) is represented by exact integer powers 2^(3n); no floating point enters.
The family rejects only the inference rule and does not prove an actual Q3 central-context no-go.
R231 checks exact rational scales only, not unbounded domains or Q3 dynamics.
No common alpha, KMS/OS reconstruction, GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A conclusion follows.
